notes: Facts only from the sources listed. Where sources disagree, the conflict is written into the field.
Abbreviations: WT = warcrafttavern.com, WSP = wowsod.pro, FC = foreverchanges.pro, WIKI = warcraft.wiki.gg, LFC = lfcarry.com, EXP = expcarry.com, WOWGG = wow.gg, GF = gfinityesports.com.

Warcraft Tavern level ranges are the in-game Looking For Group tool brackets (WT says so). They run 2 levels wider than the Blizzard blog ranges for most new dungeons. The Blizzard blog ranges are listed first.

min_level is the 'required level' to accept the quest. Most sources give it, but they sometimes disagree by 1. XP numbers differ a lot between sources (base vs scaled), so they are left out on purpose.
Wowhead /forever/ guide pages render client-side and came back empty through WebFetch. Only Wowhead quest pages and the Blizzard post mirror were readable.

new_dungeons.name: The Hall of Thanes
new_dungeons.levels: 13-18 (Blizzard blog, WSP, FC, WIKI). 13-20 per WT (LFG tool). Quests from level 9-10.

entrance.zone: Ironforge (Dun Morogh), beneath the High Seat
entrance.how: From the Great Forge go into the High Seat (King Magni's hall). Turn left (by Deliana, per WIKI) into a spiderweb-covered passage and go downstairs to the instance portal. WT warns that falling there kills you. Alliance can take the Deeprun Tram from Stormwind. Horde has to go overland (WIKI route: Undercity, Silverpine, Hillsbrad, Arathi, Wetlands, Loch Modan, Dun Morogh), and WIKI suggests taking gear off before reaching the Ironforge guards.

attunement.note: No key or attunement (WT, LFC, WIKI).
Optional breadcrumb [13] (WIKI). Starts the outdoor chain that leads to Old Ironforge Incursion.

attunement.giver: not named (chain centers on Earthseer Farsen)
attunement.note: [13] (WIKI). WIKI says the main line starts in Kharanos.
Kill 10 Dark Iron Spies around 76.7,60.7. One spy drops the Dark Iron Map, which starts a breadcrumb back to Farsen (WT).
[15]. Part 1 of the series; Old Ironforge Incursion is part 2 (Wowhead quest 96393).

quests.name: Important Heirlooms
quests.where: Ironforge, just outside the dungeon by the bridge (WSP gives 32.4,44.8)
quests.objective: Collect 8 Dwarven Heirlooms inside the dungeon, return to Thom Filch.
quests.reward: Choice: Dwarven Tome or Tomb Robber's Gloves; 7s; +100 Gadgetzan rep (WSP). Faction conflict: WT and WIKI say Alliance, FC and EXP say Both.

quests.name: The Restless Dead
quests.where: Ironforge (WSP 33.2,47.4); WT says up the stairs from the dungeon entrance
quests.objective: Kill 15 Enraged Apparitions and 10 Tormented Souls inside.
quests.reward: Choice: Dusty Belt or Cryptwalker Bracers; 7s; +100 Ironforge rep.

quests.name: Old Ironforge Incursion
quests.objective: Loot the Head of Durgen Dirgehammer (final boss), deliver it to King Magni Bronzebeard in Ironforge. Needs the Nip 'Em in the Bud / Underground Map chain first.
quests.reward: Choice: Calibrated Blunderbuss, Ironforge Greathammer or Deepblaze; 8s; +100 Ironforge, +100 Gnomeregan Exiles (Wowhead, WSP).

quests.name: An Ancient Grudge
quests.where: Inside the dungeon, second room (Anvilmar's Rest)
quests.objective: Kill Faldrim Anvilmar (first boss). Turn in to the Ghostly Attendant on the way out.
quests.reward: Choice: Catacomb Cloak or Deepgrave Trousers. FC, WIKI and EXP say Both/neutral; WT lists it Alliance-only.

quests.name: The Treaty of Understanding
quests.where: Behind a vault door in the final boss room (Reliquary of Kings)
quests.objective: Deliver the Treaty of Understanding to King Magni Bronzebeard in Ironforge. Not shareable.
quests.reward: 16s (FC); no item listed.

bosses: Magmatus (arrives with a Dark Iron Summoner; beta client named it Infurnus per LFC)

new_dungeons.name: Ruins of Lordaeron
new_dungeons.levels: 15-20 (Blizzard blog, WSP, LFC). 15-22 per WT (LFG tool) and the WIKI infobox. Every quest needs level 15 (WSP); WT gives 16 for some. EXP: Blizzard dev notes set the quest entry levels to 15.

entrance.zone: Tirisfal Glades (uninstanced Ruins of Lordaeron, above the Undercity)
entrance.how: Go to the ruined city over the Undercity. Before entering the keep, look left and climb the stairs (WT). WIKI puts the instance line near the city entrance from Brill. Horde: zeppelin Orgrimmar to Brill. Alliance: boat to Menethil, then Southshore, north through Hillsbrad and Silverpine (or swim Lordamere Lake) into Tirisfal. Entering the Undercity area flags Alliance for PvP.

attunement.note: No key or attunement listed.
Prerequisite for The New Plague (WT, WSP, WIKI).

attunement.where: Tirisfal Glades, next to Deathguard Kristof
attunement.note: Prerequisite for The Wrath of Rath'mael (WT, WIKI).

quests.name: Light's Justice
quests.objective: Collect 25 Intact Limbs from undead inside.
quests.reward: Choice: The Stitcher or Spare Part Bindings; +150 Undercity.

quests.name: The New Plague
quests.objective: Loot a Highly Toxic Strain from Witherfang. Needs the A Recipe For Death chain first.
quests.reward: Choice: Plaguefang or Blight Gloves. WT gives min level 16.

quests.name: The Wrath of Rath'mael
quests.where: Between Brill and Undercity, Tirisfal Glades (65.2,60.1)
quests.objective: Kill Rath'mael (final boss). Needs Rear Guard Patrol first.
quests.reward: Choice: Forsaken Greataxe or Gnarled Necromancer's Staff; +150 Undercity.

quests.name: A Frightened Request
quests.giver: Tabetha Heartweaver (spelled Tabitha on WSP and WIKI)
quests.objective: Find the body of Edward Heartweaver inside.
quests.reward: Choice: Edward's Knife or Tabitha's Cuffs; +150 Undercity.

quests.name: Unending Torment
quests.objective: Multi-part chain (5 parts per WIKI): bring the head to Master Apothecary Faranell in the Apothecarium, use Faranell's Hissing Serum on the Unfinished Abomination, then gather Blisterweed, Toxic Skullcap (Tawny Grisette) and Essence of Agony (Ezekiel Graves) for Faranell.
quests.reward: Not confirmed. WIKI lists Grave Shroud / Monstrous Cleaver / Slain Baron's Signet, the same items as the Alliance Abominable Creatures, so treat as unverified. Not shareable.

quests.name: Crest of Lordaeron
quests.giver: Crest of Lordaeron (object, one of five random spots inside)
quests.objective: Deliver the Crest to Oran Snakewrithe, Magic Quarter, Undercity (73.3,32.6).
quests.reward: Small Sack of Gems.

quests.name: Abominable Creatures
quests.where: Inside the dungeon, on the left at the entrance
quests.objective: Loot the Head of The Baron, return it to Captain Truman.
quests.reward: Choice: Monstrous Cleaver, Grave Shroud or Slain Baron's Signet.

quests.name: Bloodied Insignia
quests.objective: Collect 10 Bloodied Insignias, turn in to General Marcus Jonathan in Stormwind (WT body text: Valley of Heroes 69.0,82.8).
quests.reward: Choice: Duty Bound Leggings or Remembrance Armor.

quests.name: Remember That I Love You
quests.giver: Crumpled Paper beside Edward Heartweaver's body
quests.where: Inside, in the graveyard where Rath'mael is
quests.objective: Deliver the Blood-Stained Letter to Orphan Matron Nightingale, Cathedral Square, Stormwind (56.2,54.0). It has a follow-up of the same name.
quests.reward: Tarnished Locket (from part 2, WIKI); +150 Undercity listed by WSP.

quests.name: Crest of Lordaeron
quests.giver: Crest of Lordaeron (object, one of five random spots inside)
quests.objective: Deliver the Crest to Lady Dena Kennedy, Royal Gallery, Stormwind Keep (69.2,27.7).
quests.reward: Small Sack of Gems.

bosses: Viktor the Vile (secret gauntlet, started at a fireplace)
The Abandoned (secret gauntlet, started at a statue)
Lordaeron Captain (rare, west side; hostile to Horde, Alliance cannot kill him)

new_dungeons.name: Excavation Site: Wetlands
new_dungeons.levels: Sources disagree. 24-29: Blizzard blog, WSP, EXP. 26-31: the October 1 beta revision (classicwow.gg, FC, rpgstash). 26-33: WT (LFG tool) and method.gg. 26-32: WIKI. 24-32: mobalytics. Quests from 24; Relic Guardian is level 31.

entrance.zone: Wetlands (above Whelgar's Excavation, near Thelgen Rock and Dun Algaz)
entrance.coords: 48.1,56.5 (WT, dungeon entrance; the path starts about 53.9,65.4, left of Thelgen Rock). WIKI puts the summoning stone and instance line at 53.4,65.3.
entrance.how: Take the winding path up, past non-elite spiders. Alliance: road from Menethil Harbor, or run in from Loch Modan. Horde: Silverpine, then Hillsbrad (get the Tarren Mill flight path), then Arathi (Hammerfall flight path), then south over the Thandol Span into the Wetlands to the meeting stone.

attunement.note: No key or attunement.
Horde prerequisite for Open the Maw. Sends you to the Deathstalker Agent.
Alliance prerequisite for Highland Hides (WSP, WIKI).

attunement.quest: Tramping Paws, Fire Taboo, Blisters on the Land
attunement.note: Alliance prerequisites for Horrors in the Highland (WT).
Optional Alliance breadcrumb to Caitlin Grassman.

quests.name: Songblade Search
quests.objective: Find Daewyn's body in a tent in the Dragonmaw area after Shadetooth. The body gives the follow-up Fallen in the Fen, turned in to Dorin.
quests.reward: Fallen in the Fen: Daewyn's Girdle or Songblade Stabilizer.

quests.name: Lost in the Thicket Things
quests.objective: Find Ardin Grassman on a wooden structure near the Site of the Guardian. He gives the follow-up Heartwoven, which goes back to Caitlin.
quests.reward: Heartwoven: Greater Healing Potion or Mana Potion, plus Swiftness Potion / Satchel of Potions.

quests.name: Highland Hides
quests.objective: Collect 4 Thicket Raptor Hides in Stalker's Thicket near Shadetooth. Needs Young Crocolisk Skins first.
quests.reward: 12s and small XP. WT says it is not a true dungeon quest and was bugged in beta.

quests.name: Horrors in the Highland
quests.objective: Kill the optional boss Highland Horror and loot the Horrible Rootcore.
quests.reward: Choice: Ironwood Destroyer, Curl of Life or Hornbeam Heft.

quests.name: Lost Relic Carry
quests.objective: Bring the relic to Prospector Whelgar (38.8,52.3). The follow-up Prehistoric Prism goes to High Explorer Magellas, Hall of Explorers, Ironforge (69.4,19.1).
quests.reward: Prehistoric Prism: Explorer's League Dustcover, Healer's Staff or Heavehammer; 60s.

quests.name: Changing Tastes
quests.where: The Drag, Orgrimmar (57.3,53.3), 2nd floor, same hut as the cooking trainer
quests.objective: Collect 4 Thicket Raptor Meat from Thicket raptors after the first boss.
quests.reward: Choice: Satchel of Potions or Serrated Raptor Claw, plus the Twice-Spiced Raptor Slice recipe.

quests.name: Open the Maw
quests.where: Wetlands, hills above the Dragonmaw camp (51.4,59.2)
quests.objective: Kill 2 Dragonmaw Saboteurs and 4 Dragonmaw Warders and loot a Dragonmaw Dispatch (from a Dragonmaw Thaumaturgist). Needs Dragonmaw Rumors first.
quests.reward: Choice: Knife-Polishing Rag or Dirt-Heavy Bracers, plus a soulbound Bloody Map (use unclear per WT).

quests.name: Elder Knowledge
quests.objective: Bring the relic to Bashana Runetotem, Elder Rise, Thunder Bluff (70.8,33.7). The follow-up Earthen Echo goes to Muln Earthfury on the plateau in NW Mulgore (33.4,22.5).
quests.reward: Earthen Echo: Heavehammer, Healer's Staff or Furs of the Earthen Ring; 60s.

bosses: Highland Horror (optional; only needed for Horrors in the Highland)
Relic Guardian (final; start it at the Archival Panel beside a column right of the boss)

new_dungeons.name: City of Dalaran
new_dungeons.levels: 28-33 (Blizzard blog, WSP, FC, LFC). 28-35 per WT (LFG tool). Quests from 24 (WSP); EXP and the An Alarming Request quest data put the Alliance attunement quests at level 30.

entrance.zone: Alterac Mountains (Dalaran). The sewer entrance is on the Silverpine Forest side of Lordamere Lake.
entrance.coords: 69.3,45.6 on the Silverpine Forest map (WT). The Image of Archmage Modera stands outside at 68.5,45.1.
entrance.how: Groups enter through the sewers. At least one party member must hold the Dalaran Sewer Key, and one keyholder can open it for the group. Alliance: from Southshore. Horde: from Tarren Mill, or from the Sepulcher once access is granted. Since the October 15 build, Horde are attacked on sight inside the open-world city, and the Horde key no longer gives open-world city access (LFC).

attunement.note: Alliance start. Requires level 30, quest level 33. Sends you to the Image of Archmage Modera outside the sewers.

Most guides say accepting it grants the Dalaran Sewer Key; one guide says An Alarming Request gives the key. Afterwards Modera gives Friend of the Kirin Tor: deliver the Arcane Mote to Archmage Celindra in the Violet Citadel (14.2,60.1).
Horde step 1, level 30. Collect 4 Bloodstone pieces (Wedge, Marble, Shard, Oval) from neutral mobs in the Lordamere Internment Camp. Blizzard's post spells it Prison Break-In.
Horde step 2. Take the Grimy Key from the Warden's Footlocker in Kegan Darkmar's house (guarded by Warden Belamoore). The Grimy Key is not the Sewer Key.
Horde step 3. Kill 6 Dalaran Summoners and 8 Elemental Slaves.

attunement.where: Ends at the Image of Archmage Modera, Silverpine Forest (68.5,45.1)
attunement.note: Horde step 4. Talk to the Image to complete it.
Horde step 5. Grants the Dalaran Sewer Key. Turn in to Magus Wordeen Voidglare. Follow-up Shrewd Negotiations: deliver the Arcane Mote to Archmage Modera.

attunement.where: Tarren Mill, same house as Wordeen
attunement.note: Optional Horde side quests, not needed for the key (WT).

quests.name: Power Overwhelming
quests.objective: Kill the Arcanic Enigma (mana elemental patrolling NE Dalaran near the Path of Renewal).
quests.reward: Choice: Violet Sash or Runebound Gloves; 1g.

quests.name: A Green Sample
quests.objective: Collect a Fel Infused Blossom in Runeweaver Square. Magus Fansy Goodbringer drops the shield; the Fel Ancient patrols the square.
quests.reward: Choice: Vine Pruner's Cloak or Thorn Protecting Girdle.

quests.name: Starving Arcane
quests.objective: Kill 8 Seeking Remnants, 8 Saturated Remnants and 8 Mana Echoes. Needs An Alarming Request. EXP gives min level 30.
quests.reward: Choice: Fallen Guard's Pendant or Arcane Infused Rod; +100 Kirin Tor.

quests.name: Heart of Disruption
quests.objective: Loot the Arcane Mote from the Shade of the Archmage (final boss). Needs An Alarming Request. EXP gives min level 30.
quests.reward: Choice: Spellguard Pauldrons, Renewing Footpads or Defender of Dalaran; +100 Kirin Tor. Leads to Friend of the Kirin Tor.

quests.name: Source of Power
quests.objective: Collect 6 Cracked Sentry Cores from Fragmented Sentry golems (FC: six per player).
quests.reward: Choice: Unstable Power Core or Construct Cloak.

quests.name: The Grave Knight
quests.objective: Kill Atrexis the Grave Knight (first boss).
quests.reward: Choice: Gravewalker Boots or Undead Knight's Bracers; 1g.

quests.name: Opportunistic Education
quests.where: Inside the dungeon, just right of the entrance
quests.objective: Bring back the tome The Founding of Dalaran (clear the Angry Tomes in the Atrium of Fortune; take the book sticking out of the shelves).
quests.reward: Choice: Solid Gold Band or Larcenist's Belt.

quests.name: Heart of Disruption
quests.objective: Loot the Arcane Mote from the Shade of the Archmage; turn in to Magus Wordeen Voidglare. Needs Blood in the Streets. Different quest ID from the Alliance one.
quests.reward: Choice: Battle Spaulders, Enchanted Sandals or Striking Staff. Leads to Shrewd Negotiations.

bosses: Lyn the Ignored (secret; summoned with a Tome of Dalaran in the square chamber near the sewer exit)
Unstable Sentry (LFC calls it Unstable Sentinel)

new_dungeons.name: The Drowned City
new_dungeons.levels: 35-40 (Blizzard blog, WSP, LFC). 35-42 per WT (LFG tool) and the WIKI infobox. Quests from 30; final boss level 40.

entrance.zone: Stranglethorn Vale (underwater, off the west coast)
entrance.how: Underwater cavern in the Sunken Hollow, past The Vile Reef near the island with the water elementals, with a large stone tablet beside it. WIKI: south of the Haunted Isle, due west of Grom'gol. Swim west from Grom'gol or north from Booty Bay. Bring water breathing. Nearest flight paths: Booty Bay (neutral) and Grom'gol (Horde).

attunement.note: No key or attunement.

attunement.quest: The Second Rebellion & Bad Medicine -> Troll Witchery
attunement.note: Alliance chain leading to Take Two With Water (WIKI). EXP ties Magics of the Drowned City to the same chain.
Horde prerequisite for The Drowned City (EXP, LFC).
Horde prerequisite for The Only Good Brinescale... (WIKI chain: The Drowned City -> Enemies in the Water -> The Only Good Brinescale...).

quests.name: Magics of the Drowned City
quests.objective: Collect 5 I'lalai Fetish.
quests.reward: No item listed; +100 Stormwind.

quests.name: Take Two With Water
quests.objective: Collect the First, Second, Third and Fourth Tablets of I'lalai.
quests.reward: 1g 50s; +100 Stormwind.

quests.name: Ancient Gurubashi Secrets
quests.objective: Bring the Ancient Gurubashi Idol (drops from Deathless Marrow).
quests.reward: 50s; +300 Kirin Tor, +150 Stormwind.

quests.name: The Drowned City
quests.objective: Collect (rub) the four Tablets of I'lalai. LFC: continues to A Tale Spun, finished in Sen'jin.
quests.reward: A Tale Spun (LFC): Ceremonial Mallet, Sacrificial Sword or I'lalai Flayer. +100 Darkspear, +100 Orgrimmar.

quests.name: The Only Good Brinescale...
quests.objective: Kill Var'Taka (WSP). LFC instead says collect 10 Brinescale Tridents from Brinescale Skirmishers. Unverified which is current.
quests.reward: Choice: Tidesoaked Leggings or Naga Priestess's Mantle; 1g 30s.

quests.name: Ancient Gurubashi Idol
quests.objective: Recover the Ancient Gurubashi Idol from Deathless Marrow. LFC gives min level 28.
quests.reward: 1g; +300 Earthen Ring, +150 Darkspear.

quests.name: Shady Saltseers
quests.objective: Collect 10 Voodoo-Infused Artifacts.
quests.reward: Choice: Rusted Troll War Belt or Saltseer's Helm; 1g; Booty Bay and other Steamwheedle rep.

quests.name: The Saltseer Captain
quests.objective: Kill Captain Dreadrise and 3 Saltseer Coroners.
quests.reward: Choice: Mutinous Cuffs or South Seas Shroud.

bosses: Deathless Marrow (drops the Ancient Gurubashi Idol)
Min'loth the Serpent (final; the storm sanctum)
Rares (not always up): Umbra, Gill, "Pyromancer" Braxton

Order conflict: WT lists the order above; LFC runs Zul'Alai, Captain Dreadrise, Primeval Elemental, Var'Taka, Deathless Marrow, Min'loth; WIKI runs Zul'Alai, Var'Taka, Primeval Elemental, Captain Dreadrise, Deathless Marrow, Min'loth. Zin'aka (level 45 elite shark) is not a boss (LFC).

new_dungeons.name: Krol'dok Stronghold
new_dungeons.levels: 40-45 (Blizzard corrected it from an initially posted 40-55; WSP, WIKI, WOWGG, FC). 40-47 per WT (LFG tool). Quests from 37.

entrance.zone: Riverglades (new Forever zone; reached from Redridge Mountains or the Badlands)
entrance.how: On a hill over Sunnyglade on the north side of the zone, next to the closed main gates. WT says the cave is west of the gates; WOWGG says the portal is slightly east of the city entrance. Alliance: fly to Farholde Keep and head north to Sunnyglade, or walk in from Redridge. Horde: fly to the Horde town (spelled Rog'mar by WOWGG, Rom'gar by WT, Rogm'ar by WIKI; exact spelling unverified), or walk in from the Badlands.

attunement.note: No entry key listed. Key Ingredients rewards a Krol'dok Compound Key, and Mugg drops a Krol'dok Ogre Key, but no source says what either opens.

attunement.quest: Clugfist's Decree, then the chain starting with The Wayward Warrior
attunement.note: Horde prerequisites for the Horde dungeon quests (WT; WSP lists The Wayward Warrior as prereq for A Token of Vengeance and Tome of Twilight).

attunement.quest: Scraps of Knowledge, Curious Trinkets, Saving Sunnyglade
attunement.note: Alliance prerequisites (WT, WSP). WOWGG adds A Small Favor before Tome of Twilight.
Key Ingredients: bring 4 Thick Leather and 12 Iron Bar for the Krol'dok Compound Key.

quests.name: Vengeance of the Highborne
quests.objective: Kill Zalfan Moonshadow, a Twilight Warlock inside.
quests.reward: 65s; +250 Kirin Tor, +150 Brotherhood of the Horse.

quests.name: Twilight Mementos
quests.objective: Collect 8 Twilight Bangles from cultists. Follow-ups: Lingering Essence (deliver the Satchel of Cursed Mementos to Ashe Amberhall) and Curios of Curiosity (deliver to Melanie Sable, 66.2,83.2).
quests.reward: +150 Brotherhood of the Horse. Curios of Curiosity gives the Curio-Adorned Necklace.

quests.name: Tome of Twilight
quests.objective: Take the Tome of Twilight from Nar'gurk.
quests.reward: Choice: Twilight Initiate's Belt or Torn Cultist Cloak; +150 Brotherhood of the Horse.

quests.name: Eye of Mugg
quests.objective: Bring the Eye of Mugg from Overlord Mugg (final boss).
quests.reward: Choice: Rock on Stick, Stick No Rock or Bigger Rock on Bigger Stick; 1g 30s; +150 Brotherhood of the Horse.

quests.name: Krol'dok Moulding
quests.objective: Take it to Alphonse Dumas, Farholde Keep (64.4,82.0). Leads to Key Ingredients.

quests.name: Krol'dok No More!
quests.objective: not recorded
quests.reward: Choice of two items (names not recorded). Listed only by WSP; unverified.

quests.name: A Token of Vengeance
quests.objective: Collect 15 Cultist Ears inside.
quests.reward: Semblance of Twilight (neck). WSP names the giver Commander Aggro'gosh at the same coordinates, which looks like a data error.

quests.name: Tome of Twilight
quests.objective: Take the Tome of Twilight from Nar'gurk.
quests.reward: Choice: Indoctrinated Choker or Convert's Bindings.

quests.name: Eye of Mugg
quests.objective: Bring the Eye of Mugg from Overlord Mugg.
quests.reward: Choice: Rock on Stick, Stick No Rock or Bigger Rock on Bigger Stick; 1g 30s.

quests.name: Krol'dok Moulding
quests.objective: Take it to Kreza Darkthorn in the Horde town (59.8,46.0). Leads to Key Ingredients.

bosses: War Handler Ashka (kill her two pets first)
Overlord Mugg (final; kill his two centurions first)
Note: FC and LFC count 5 bosses; WT, WOWGG and WIKI list these 6.

new_dungeons.name: Alcaz Prison
new_dungeons.levels: 48-53 (Blizzard blog, WSP, LFC, WIKI). 48-55 per WT (LFG tool; WT calls it Alcaz Island Prison). Quests from 46-48, all quest level 53; final boss level 51.

entrance.zone: Dustwallow Marsh (Alcaz Island, off the northeast coast)
entrance.how: The portal is in the stone basement of the large central keep on the island; from the dock take the path up the hill to the left. Alliance: swim northeast from Theramore Isle. Horde: ride east from Brackenwall Village along the coast. Elite naga patrol the climb (LFC).

attunement.note: No attunement. WT: most quests need outdoor prerequisite chains.
Alliance chain start (WT). WIKI chain: Our Man in Theramore -> Watch Yer Back -> The Return of the King? -> The Secret Prison.
Horde chain start (WT). WIKI chain: The Missing Kor'kron -> The Elite of the Elite -> Right Place, Wrong Time -> No Orc Left Behind.

quests.name: A Little Payback
quests.objective: Kill Strashaz naga (EXP: 15 Strashaz Soldiers, 8 Enchantresses) and Tidemistress Ca'zass; loot Ca'zass's head.
quests.reward: Choice: Kor'kron Battle Gauntlets, Marshdweller's Pants or Naga Scale Spaulders; 80s.

quests.name: Blood Red Bandanas
quests.objective: Kill Defias inmates and collect bandanas.
quests.reward: Choice: Bloodsplattered Bandana or Makeshift Belt.

quests.name: No Orc Left Behind
quests.objective: Rescue the Kor'kron prisoners. Last step of The Missing Kor'kron chain.
quests.reward: +150 Orgrimmar (WSP). LFC credits it with the Thrall Needs to Know rewards.

quests.name: The Honor of the Kor'kron
quests.where: Inside the prison, after Katerina the Cleaner
quests.objective: Completed through the note found after Zarla. LFC says it needs Bad News for Folkar, Blood Red Bandanas and A Little Payback.
quests.reward: +100 Orgrimmar.

quests.name: Bad News for Folkar
quests.objective: Bring the note to Commander Folkar. It leads to Thrall Needs to Know (report to Thrall, Orgrimmar). WIKI spells it Bad News for Fokar.
quests.reward: Thrall Needs to Know: Fatebound Buckler, Courier's Clasp or Dustwallow Dirk.

quests.name: A Bit of Wet Work
quests.objective: Kill Strashaz naga and loot Ca'zass's head.
quests.reward: Choice: Theramore Defender's Gauntlets, Marshdweller's Pants or Naga Scale Spaulders; 80s.

quests.name: The Dragon's Journal
quests.objective: Loot Zarla's Journal from Zarla Ober / Blazeroar. No prerequisite.
quests.reward: 80s; +300 Kirin Tor, +150 Stormwind.

quests.name: The Secret Prison
quests.objective: Explore Alcaz Prison and learn what became of Varian Wrynn; completed through the note in Zarla's room. Last step of the Our Man in Theramore chain. Not shareable.
quests.reward: +150 Stormwind.

quests.name: Somber News
quests.objective: not recorded
quests.reward: +75 Stormwind. Listed only by WSP; unverified.

quests.name: Shaw Needs to Know
quests.objective: not recorded
quests.reward: Courier's Clasp, Dustwallow Dirk or Fatebound Buckler (WIKI). Faction is a guess from the name (WIKI shows no faction marker): looks like the Alliance mirror of Thrall Needs to Know. Unverified.

quests.name: The Man in the Iron Chains
quests.where: Inside, Zarla's room / end of the dungeon
quests.objective: Kill The Questioner and bring the Ornate Shackle Key to Mason. LFC gives two different step orders; check in game.

classic_dungeon_changes: Level ranges: no source shows an official Blizzard change to a classic dungeon's range. The only differences from Classic Era are Warcraft Tavern's LFG brackets for Wailing Caverns (15-24 vs 17-24) and Shadowfang Keep (20-30 vs 22-30). FC says classic ranges are still unconfirmed for Forever. Treat as unverified.
Quests (WSP): 65 classic dungeon quests had their rewards changed, and 104 quests are new (count covers new and classic dungeons).

New quests in classic dungeons (WSP): Deadmines: Destruction in Deadmines (Alliance, Alba Fairmoon, Westfall 52.4,53, req 9) and A Moon-Kissed Blade (Paladin class quest, Lumina Windsinger, Silverpine 43,40, req 20). Scarlet Monastery: Past Due (Alliance, Magus Olvek). Razorfen Downs: The Coldbringer's Eye (Alliance and Horde versions; Horde from Sutara Plainstalker, Mulgore) and Agamaggan's Blood (Both). Zul'Farrak: The Witch Doctor's Head (Alliance, 39) and Zum'rah's Head (Horde, 42). Maraudon: Rot and Regret (Both, 35) and An'she's Radiance (Horde, 43). Blackrock Depths: Fragment of the Firelands (Horde, 46). Blackrock Spire: Blood and Thunder (Horde, 55). Dire Maul: The Broken Glaive (52). Most givers are not recorded yet.

Changed-reward classic quests (WSP): Deadmines: Red Silk Bandanas, Collecting Memories, Oh Brother... (also renamed), Underground Assault. Razorfen Kraul: nearly all (Blueleaf Tubers, Willix the Importer, Mortality Wanes, A Vengeful Fate, The Crone of the Kraul). Blackfathom Deeps: separate Alliance and Horde quest lists, nearly all rewards changed. Razorfen Downs: An Unholy Alliance, Bring the End, Bring the Light. Zul'Farrak: Tiara of the Deep, Divino-matic Rod. BRD: Abandoned Hope, The Last Element, The Royal Rescue, The Princess Saved?, The Love Potion, Hurley Blackbreath, Lost Thunderbrew Recipe, Operation: Death to Angerforge. Blackrock Spire: The Demon Forge.

Dungeon XP: Oct 1 beta build halved the extra XP dungeon quests give beyond a normal quest (FC: now about 2.1x Classic, was 3.1x). Oct 8: dungeon kill XP +20%, and party kill XP uses each player's own level. Nov 10 hotfix: dungeon kill XP +50% more. Blizzard says kill XP is still below Classic Era, and most dungeon XP now comes from one-time quests (WT, LFC, mein-mmo).

Loot: every dungeon drop was re-examined and hundreds of new drops were added (classicwow.gg). Unique boss items are blue, bosses drop Blueprint (campsite) recipes, and uncommon/rare drops unlock the appearance for every eligible looter (LFC, WT). WT notes loot changes in Wailing Caverns (a Druid set bonus giving a serpent Cat Form look) and Shadowfang Keep.

Systems: no Dungeon Finder; a manual Looking For Group listing that does not teleport, and Meeting Stones cannot summon. One difficulty only (no heroic/mythic). Instance resets up to 5 per hour. Tarnished Undermine Real is a dungeon currency. Clearing each dungeon once on the Novice, Experienced or Master Spelunker challenge gives 1 Legacy Point each (WT).
Scarlet Monastery and Dire Maul are handled as one dungeon group with separate wings (EXP); WT and FC list the wings separately.

Unverified (LFC only): a Nov 17 hotfix restored Upper Blackrock Spire enemy health and damage to raid-level tuning, and Agamaggan's Blood is no longer a dungeon quest (LFC ties it to Shen'dralar; WSP lists it under Razorfen Downs). Not found in the official hotfix pages that were checked.

Classic dungeon fixes in the Nov 9-16 hotfixes: Blackfathom Deeps release-after-death bug; BRD throne room doors after a Thaurissan wipe; Heart of the Mountain lootable more than once; BRD door after Ever After teleports correctly; Stratholme mounting disabled; Sunken Temple Atal'alarion statues stay usable if activated out of order; Zul'Farrak Talisman of Kazdor no longer sends rogues to the wrong version.
Datamined, unconfirmed extra dungeons listed by zockify: Half-Pint Tavern (Arathi Highlands, recommended 32) and Manor Mistmantle (Duskwood). Unverified.
